postconditions.expression: all(len(A_i) > 0 for A_i in A_set for A_set in A_sets)
all(len(set(A_i)) == len(A_i) for A_i in A_sets)
postconditions.description: Each set consists of distinct integers.

postconditions.expression: all(A_set != other_A_set for A_set in A_sets for other_A_set in A_sets if A_set != other_A_set)
all(b[i-1][j-1] == 1 if A_i_set.issubset(A_j_set) and A_i_set != A_j_set else b[i-1][j-1] == 0 for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, n+1) for A_i_set in A_sets for A_j_set in A_sets)
postconditions.description: For all pairs (i,j), b[i,j] is 1 if A_i is a proper subset of A_j and 0 otherwise.
